sentences.text: type=fact The in-force UCB directions say that for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and that applies to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-01-01.
type=fact The bank’s in-force home-loan documents state a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.

type=fact On the facts given, a clause that requires a pre-payment charge for this floating-rate, non-business individual home loan sanctioned in 2026 would not comply with the in-force RBI directions.
